name: Offroader V6 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Offroader V6 is an awesome 3D game of driving exploration in which you can race through a large open-world and city. Before you head out into the open city, you can choose your vehicle – there is a range of different vehicles to choose from including sports cars, trucks, and even a giant green bus (the bus is fun to drive!).
